identity.name: Portugieser Automatic
identity.one_liner: The 42.3mm Portugieser Automatic with the 7-day power reserve — the most-cited IWC dress/sport watch, a watch with a railway-track dial and a Pellaton winding system.

narrative.story: The IW500710 is the modern Portugieser Automatic, in production since 2000. The 51011 caliber is a Pellaton-winding automatic with a 7-day reserve, the longest in the modern IWC catalogue. The 42.3mm stainless steel case has the railway-track dial, the Arabic numerals, and the small seconds at 6 that are the Portugieser's signature. The IW500710 is the most-cited IWC dress/sport watch because the 7-day reserve and the readable dial are the two IWC features a watch collector cites when arguing IWC belongs in the haute horlogerie conversation.
narrative.collector_notes: The Pellaton winding system is a bidirectional pawl-and-ratchet system that winds the mainspring with both directions of rotor rotation. The 7-day reserve is achieved with two barrels.
